# Checks the land gates may merge through when red. One entry per line: a
# bare check name excuses that whole check; `check-name:test_name` names one
# flaky test inside a suite check and only marks its job log worth reading.
# Blank lines and # comments are not entries. Read by the flow land gates
# from THIS file on the base branch: an entry added on a PR excuses nothing.

# a line of the diff. GitHub-side; nothing in this repository configures it.
